message: Thanks. A few questions: Which state do you live in? How many people are in your household? Roughly how much does the household earn from work per year (before tax)? Does anyone get health insurance through a job? Roughly how much is in bank accounts and investments?
reply: New Mexico. Two of us. Around $9,500 a month. No idea, honestly. We have some savings and investments.

summary: Household of 2, no kids, healthy, in their 30s, in New Mexico, earning about $114k/year. That is above the limits for SNAP, Medicaid and EITC. It is also above the 400% FPL cutoff for the ACA premium tax credit, which is back in force now that the enhanced subsidies have expired. No kids, so WIC, CHIP, CTC, TANF and school meals don't apply. No disability or age, so SSI doesn't apply.
